  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And (∀ (b : Bool), Eq (QuarticQuery.bitSign b) (HPow.hPow (-1) (ite (Eq b true) 1 0)))
    (And
      (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
        Eq (QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)
          (HPow.hPow (-1)
            ((Finset.range (HMul.hMul 2 t)).sum fun b => ite (Eq (((↑i).testBit b).and ((↑j).testBit b)) true) 1 0)))
      (And
        (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
          Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t i j)
            (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt) ↑(QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)))
        (And
          (∀ (i : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
            Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.u t i) (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt))
          (∀ (h : Fin k),
            Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.signDiag z h)
              (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(QuarticQuery.bitSign (z (Prod.mk h i))))))))

theorem construction_walsh_definitions (k t : ℕ)
    (z : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t)) :
    (∀ b : Bool, bitSign b = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (if b then (1 : ℕ) else 0)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (mValue t), walshSign t i j =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (∑ b ∈ range (2 * t),
        if i.val.testBit b && j.val.testBit b then (1 : ℕ) else 0)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin (mValue t), H t i j =
      (Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ))⁻¹ * (walshSign t i j : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin (mValue t), u t i = (Real.sqrt (mValue t : ℝ))⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin k, signDiag z h = Matrix.diagonal fun i => (bitSign (z (h, i)) : ℝ))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_1_ii_complete (k : Nat) (hk : LE.le 1 k) :
  Exists fun A =>
    And (LT.lt 0 A)
      (∀ (t : Nat) (η : Real),
        LT.lt 0 η →
          LT.lt η (1 / 2) →
            Exists fun n =>
              Exists fun L =>
                Exists fun Z =>
                  Exists fun instZ =>
                    have x := instZ;
                    Exists fun o =>
                      Exists fun out =>
                        Exists fun F =>
                          And
                            (LE.le (↑(HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)))
                              (HMul.hMul A (HAdd.hAdd 1 (Real.log (HDiv.hDiv 1 η)))))
                            (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (HMul.hMul n k) F)
                              (And
                                (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                  Eq (L z b) (QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F z) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b))
                                (And
                                  (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
                                    And (LE.le 0 (L z false))
                                      (And (LE.le 0 (L z true)) (Eq (HAdd.hAdd (L z false) (L z true)) 1)))
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                      Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some b) → LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 η) (L z b))
                                    (Exists fun instI =>
                                      have x_1 := instI;
                                      Exists fun w =>
                                        Exists fun emb =>
                                          Exists fun K =>
                                            ∀
                                              (next :
                                                QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t) w),
                                              And
                                                (LE.le (K next).queryCap
                                                  (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)) next.queryCap))
                                                (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))
                                                  (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg Z) (b : Bool),
                                                  Eq ((K next).outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b)
                                                    (next.outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ((F z) ψ))
                                                      b))))))))

theorem construction_lemma_2_1_ii_complete (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (t : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → η < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (L : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t) → Bool → ℝ)
        (Z : Type) (instZ : Fintype Z),

theorem construction_lemma_2_1_complete (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t → Lvalue k t < R (P k t)) ∧
    (∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (t : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → η < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (L : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t) → Bool → ℝ)
        (Z : Type) (instZ : Fintype Z),
        let _ := instZ
        ∃ (o : Z) (out : Z → Bool)
          (F : BitInput (ForrelationCoord k t) → Reg Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Reg Z),
          ((2 * (n * k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ A * (1 + Real.log (1 / η)) ∧
          IsCirc (n * k) F ∧
          (∀ z b, L z b = lawOf (F z (rket o)) out b) ∧
          (∀ z, 0 ≤ L z false ∧ 0 ≤ L z true ∧ L z false + L z true = 1) ∧
          (∀ z b, P k t z = some b → 1 - η ≤ L z b) ∧
          ∃ instI : Inhabited (ForrelationCoord k t),
            let _ := instI
            ∃ (w : ℕ) (emb : Z ↪ Fin (w + 1))
              (K : AdaptiveProgram (ForrelationCoord k t) w →
                AdaptiveProgram (ForrelationCoord k t) w),
              ∀ next, (K next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (n * k) + next.queryCap ∧
                ∀ z ψ b, (K next).outputMass z (clEmb emb ψ) b =
                  next.outputMass z (clEmb emb (F z ψ)) b) ∧
    (∃ S : ℕ, 0 < S ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t → ∃ C : Circuit (ForrelationCoord k t),
      CircuitRealises C (P k t) ∧
      (C.size : ℝ) ≤ (S : ℝ) * (mValue t : ℝ) *
        (Real.logb 2 (mValue t : ℝ)) ^ 2)
